question: What is worshipped as the inner body of the one lord of consciousness?
premises: The one lord of consciousness has an inner body.
That inner body is pratibhā, creative intuition.
It is worshipped as the wheel of waves of consciousness, gentle or otherwise measured.
inference: The object of worship is ultimately the inner intuitive body of consciousness itself, appearing as its wave-wheel.
plain_english: For the one lord of consciousness, the inner body is indeed creative intuition; as gentle or in another measured form, the wheel of waves of consciousness is worshipped.
